notes: Desktop appliance (not natively rack-mountable; optional MRCH/RACK/KIT fits up to two units in 1RU). SDI input/output are 3G-SDI capable BNCs, compliant with SMPTE 259M/292M/424M(Level A)/425M — graded sdi-3g. HDMI in/out max 1920x1080, no version stated by Matrox; graded hdmi-1.4 (medium confidence, inferred from 1080p60 max and product era). HDMI Out is a preview/monitoring output of the selected input signal, not an independent output. SDI Out is a 0-frame-latency passthrough of the SDI input with a hardware bypass relay (closes on power failure). Audio in/out are unbalanced stereo 3.5mm line-level jacks (audio in is separate from embedded HDMI/SDI audio, which is processed internally, not a physical port). 2x USB 2.0 (Type-A) are storage ports for recording, not general host/data ports, but tagged usb-a/bidirectional per the port-direction convention; graded usb-2.0 per spec. SD/SDHC/SDXC card slot has no listed connector id in the allowed list and is omitted from ports. Power: device takes 9-24VDC via a locking DIN4 connector from an included external AC/DC power supply; the supply itself has an IEC320-C8 (figure-8) inlet for a country-specific AC cord (US/GB/EU cords included). Represented the DC input to the device as xlr4-dc is not applicable (it's a DIN4, not XLR) — closest listed id is dc-barrel (external DC adapter), noted as a locking DIN4 barrel-style connector, not a standard coaxial barrel. Product is EOL (Matrox announced EOL April 2025); Matrox recommends Maevex 7100 Series or Monarch LCS as replacements. Front-panel push buttons for Start/Stop are physical controls, not signal ports, and are omitted.
